title: Hausdorff measure on a cone: spheres are null and |x|^α is integrable near 0 (α > −m) and near ∞ (β < −m)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and M ⊆ ℝ^P with 0 ∉ M, closure(M) ⊆ M ∪ {0}, tx ∈ M for all x ∈ M and t > 0, and H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K (H^m = μHE[m]). Then (a) H^m(M ∩ {|x| = c}) = 0 for every c > 0; (b) ∫⁻_{M ∩ {|x| < 1}} ofReal(|x|^α) dH^m < ∞ for every real α > −m; (c) ∫⁻_{M ∖ {|x| < 1}} ofReal(|x|^β) dH^m < ∞ for every real β < −m (real powers).
